observed_anchors: Current acceptance contract requires restart/recovery/rollback/state-lineage continuity for the same accepted target identity.
PR #267 selected-head CAS candidate explicitly protects sibling selection only while its selected-head store survives and explicitly does not claim joint rollback safety.

PR #240 external generation floor explicitly protects DB snapshot rollback only if the anchor survives outside the protected snapshot root and explicitly does not claim whole-VM/filesystem rollback safety.
Current implementation main has SQLite 3.53.4 parity/runtime hardening work, but F-V01-13 remains open pending productive fixed-runtime/root-anchor/service plus recovery evidence.

external_primary_evidence.finding: WAL-reset corruption affects 3.7.0 through 3.51.2 and is fixed in 3.51.3 and later; current 3.53.4 is on the fixed side.
Append-only consistency proofs detect rollback/fork relative to a previously known external tree head; an independently retained prior commitment is the critical comparison point.

grf.generated_reality: A locally persisted selected lineage head plus semantic-root match is sufficient to make rollback continuity self-verifying.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: If both the selected-head authority and protected semantic state are restored to one older mutually consistent snapshot, all in-band checks can remain green while temporal continuity has regressed.
grf.falsifier: Advance a synthetic selected-head/state pair from generation 0 to 1, then restore both authority and protected state from the same generation-0 snapshot and run only in-band integrity/head-state consistency checks.
grf.predicted_if_generated_reality_right: The coherent rollback is detected despite both restored artifacts agreeing.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality_right: SQLite integrity and restored head-state consistency pass and rollback is invisible without a surviving external commitment.
grf.confidence: HIGH for the mechanism property; this is synthetic local replication, not target-VPS production evidence

go_out_of_box.name: COHERENT_SELECTED_HEAD_AND_STATE_ROLLBACK
go_out_of_box.intervention: Restore both selected-head DB and protected semantic-state file from the same generation-0 snapshot after generation 1 had been reached.
go_out_of_box.interpretation: Replication confirms the already documented PR #240/#267 limitation. It does not establish a new product defect beyond that declared boundary and does not justify a duplicate local counter patch.

fusion.external_generation_floor: RETAIN for rollback of a narrower snapshot domain when its anchor survives
fusion.whole_failure_domain_invariant: For any rollback domain claimed by v0.1, at least one comparison commitment used for admission must survive outside that same rollback domain; otherwise normal execution must fail closed or that rollback domain must be explicitly excluded by owner-fixed acceptance semantics.

fusion.tpm_monotonic_candidate: GENERATED_DESIGN_OPTION_ONLY; only usable if the accepted Hostinger target actually exposes a suitable non-rollback hardware/provider primitive, which is currently unverified.
fusion.reason: The counterworld replicates an already explicit boundary. The unresolved decision is the actual accepted target rollback failure domain and available out-of-domain monotonic authority, not another in-band counter.

next_discriminating_falsifier.action: Inventory the accepted Hostinger production/recovery boundary for an out-of-snapshot monotonic or externally witnessed commitment source, then compose it with selected semantic-lineage head admission and run rollback/restart/restore controls on the exact productive path.
